newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac reaffirms Thomson to be privatised.
newsitem.headline: Chirac reaffirms Thomson to be privatised.

text.p: A spokeswoman for President Jacques Chirac said on Wednesday the privatisation of electronics group Thomson SA would go ahead to create a large French defence group.

"The French defence electronics industry can lay claim to being world class. The privatisation of Thomson is key to creating the necessary 'poles of excellence' needed to achieve this ambition," she said.
"The government will carry it out (the sale) in accordance with the terms set on February 22" by the president, she said.

Chirac announced plans in February to sell Thomson under three conditions -- the buyer would be French, it would not break up the group, and the privatisation would be used to form the core of a French defence electronics sector.

The government called off the sale of Thomson earlier on Wednesday to Lagardere Groupe. It scrapped the sale after the independent privatisation commission objected to Lagardere's plans to sell Thomson's consumer electronics unit to South Korea's Daewoo Electronics.
